def expected_questions(length, num_strings, possible_chars):
    expected_questions = np.zeros(length)
    for start in range(length-1, -1, -1):

    dp = [[-1, -1] for _ in range(r-l+1)]

    min_collection = [math.inf] * (N + 1)
